description: Painted workshop backgrounds and transparent sprite atlases. Original PNGs; no external runtime services.

assets.prompt: NEW richly painted medieval blacksmith interior inspired by the supplied style reference. Fixed camera, three leaded windows left, small stone forge at back right, rough old timber, modest warm fire. Clear centre and lower foreground for separate anvil/katana/hammer, clear left-midground for apprentice. No people, anvil, blades, UI or text.

Edit this game background to WORKSHOP UPGRADE LEVEL 1. Preserve EXACT camera, room proportions and empty foreground for separate anvil/hammer and left-midground person. Make this first upgrade visibly different: newly repaired lighter timber walls, sturdier timber posts, a proper broad workbench spanning the back wall with orderly tools, leather bellows attached to the small stone hearth at back right, extra copper lanterns, neat crates and barrel. Modest, still rustic. Keep 3 left windows in same places and stone hearth on right. No people, anvils, weapons or foreground machinery. Rich realistic painterly medieval fantasy game environment, warm amber window/fire light, detailed aged wood and stone. Full landscape image no text no UI.

Edit this game background to WORKSHOP UPGRADE LEVEL 2. Preserve EXACT camera, room proportions and empty foreground for separate anvil/hammer and left-midground person. Obvious architectural upgrade: back wall is now half dressed stone, hearth on right much wider with a tall dressed-stone chimney and iron hood, broad sturdy stone tile path on floor amid timber, two tall tool racks on back wall, good benches and shelves along far edges only. Keep three left windows and room composition. Warm richer fire and daylight. No people, anvils, weapons or foreground machinery. Rich realistic painterly medieval fantasy game background, detailed textured timber stone and iron, landscape no text no UI.

Edit reference room into WORKSHOP UPGRADE LEVEL 3, a busy professional medieval smithy. Keep EXACT original camera room structure, 3 leaded windows LEFT and hearth RIGHT, and EMPTY central and lower foreground floor reserved for separate sprites. Clearly upgraded interior: arched stone alcoves replacing the back timber wall, organized shelves of ingots behind centre, large dark iron hood above broad glowing right hearth, two beautiful wood workbenches at far edges, orderly copper vessels and leather bellows, stone floor with timber border, reinforced ceiling beams and hanging copper lanterns. Rich painterly realistic fantasy RPG art with textured materials warm amber daylight and fire. No people, no anvils, no blades, no tools floating in foreground, no text no UI. Landscape same framing.

Edit reference room into WORKSHOP UPGRADE LEVEL 4, a prosperous master blacksmith atelier. Same exact camera original room composition, keep THREE leaded windows at LEFT and furnace on RIGHT; empty central lower floor for separate foreground sprites and clear left-midground standing area. Visibly upgraded architecture: full dressed stone back wall with arched alcoves, carved dark timber pillars banded with brass, broad sophisticated furnace with copper hood and side bellows at right, fine cabinets at far edges, hanging copper lamps, brass tool racks in rear, shelves of ingots, detailed geometric laid stone floor. Rich but grounded medieval craftsmanship, no magic. Warm golden sunlight and strong orange firelight. Highly detailed painterly realistic game environment. No people, no anvils, no swords or foreground machinery, no text no UI, landscape.

Transform this room to WORKSHOP UPGRADE LEVEL 5, final legendary master forge. Preserve exact camera 3 windows LEFT, forge RIGHT, empty centre and bottom foreground floor for compositing anvil. Clear left midground for apprentice. Make this an architectural masterpiece in same room: elegant vaulted stone rear wall, richly carved massive dark oak beams, copper and iron double-chamber forge with wide chimney at right, twin leather bellows, elaborate ingot cabinets and exquisite tool wall at back, heraldic metal crest without text above centre, small red leather banners by upper pillars, fine stone floor with brass inset borders, luxurious copper lanterns. Warm cinematic sunbeams through leaded windows, vivid golden hearth, painterly realistic fantasy medieval blacksmith workshop. No people, no anvils, no swords, no foreground machine. Whole image not montage, same landscape framing, no UI no letters.

Create a TRANSPARENT PNG game sprite atlas, 6 equal columns by 2 equal rows on a wide landscape canvas, EXACT 12 separate sprites, invisible grid no dividers no text. Each sprite fully isolated with transparent margin inside its cell. Painterly realistic medieval RPG textures, warm natural upper left lighting, three-quarter front view consistent across all. TOP ROW: six blacksmith HAMMERS in SAME pose, head horizontal at top, handle angled down to lower-right (toward 5 o'clock), whole tool visible, comparable scale filling each cell. Left to right: 0 small worn square iron head with plain ash handle; 1 heavier rectangular iron head with dark wrapped grip; 2 very broad polished steel head with red leather grip; 3 octagonal blue-steel head with studded dark leather grip; 4 large silver head with brass collars and black grip; 5 ornate black-and-gold MASTER smith hammer with engraved rectangular head and rich red wrapped handle. BOTTOM ROW: six blacksmith ANVILS firmly on short heavy stump/pedestal, SAME 3/4 view with horn pointing LEFT and horizontal working face at the SAME height in each cell. Left to right: 0 small worn iron anvil on rough stump; 1 bigger anvil on iron-banded stump; 2 broad bright steel anvil on substantial square oak base with RED iron straps; 3 dark blue steel anvil on riveted iron pedestal; 4 polished silver steel anvil on elaborate carved stone pedestal with brass corners; 5 elegant engraved master anvil with restrained brass edging on heavy black iron pedestal with golden emblems. Noticeable silhouette and material change at EACH step, not just tints. No swords no hands no environment no ground plane no shadows outside cells. REAL ALPHA transparent background, no baked checkerboard. Precise equal 6 by 2 sprite grid.

edits.prompt: Background removal only. Keep EXACTLY all 12 existing hammer and anvil sprites, their pixels, shapes, original positions, scale, six-column two-row layout and canvas aspect ratio. Remove ALL of the current white/light grey background and grey drop shadows to REAL FULL alpha=0 transparency everywhere between and around the objects, including entire outer margins. Current image has an unwanted semi-opaque white background; eliminate it completely, no white haze, no checkerboard. Preserve solid textured metals wood straps and every object. Do not redraw or rearrange any sprites, do not crop. Transparent PNG isolated game sprite atlas.

assets.prompt: Create a TRANSPARENT PNG character sprite atlas with EXACTLY FIVE equally wide cells in ONE horizontal row, invisible grid no text. Full-body blacksmith apprentice SAME adult man age 25 dark short hair stubble at five skill levels, medieval European workshop worker, realistic painterly RPG illustration matching richly textured wood-and-stone amber-lit forge. All five characters same height and 3/4 view facing RIGHT slightly, boots on SAME baseline, each centred in own equal cell with transparent clear space separating cells. Authentic hands. 1 far left: humble linen shirt rolled sleeves, short plain worn tan apron, holds iron tongs down at side. 2: red shirt, longer brown leather apron, sturdy gloves, carries hammer on shoulder. 3: dark olive shirt, reinforced leather apron with rivets and tool belt, holds large tongs. 4: charcoal shirt, long dark leather apron with brass buckles, heavy gauntlets, carries polished smith hammer on shoulder. 5 far right: deep red shirt, splendid black master apron with brass edging, wide equipped tool belt, heavy gloves, holds ornate hammer. Same face and physique all five, clearly different outfits and tools; relaxed standing work poses. Whole bodies including heads and boots visible, no chopped tools, no armor, no hats, no weapons, no panels, no captions, no UI, no background scenery or floor. TRUE alpha transparency no checkered pattern.
